title: CanonData
subtitle: Financial Data Reconciliation & Audit Engine
summary: Commercial B2B system that reads CSV exports from Shopify, Amazon, Meta, and Google and rebuilds one consistent view of orders, inventory, ad spend, and customers. Every figure traces to its source file, row, and column via SHA-256 hashing and cell lineage. Nine leak detectors sit behind a common interface, and language-model answers must match engine-computed numbers within 0.5% or are replaced. Seven FastAPI routers, 200+ Pytest cases; within 2% of the answer key on a 9,578-error synthetic benchmark.

title: Nimbus
subtitle: Sandboxed Task Execution Control Plane
summary: Runs each task in a disposable Docker container with all Linux capabilities dropped, no-new-privileges, and limits of 1 GB memory, 2 CPUs, and 256 processes. Redis/arq worker queue, WebSocket streaming of task output, and a per-task event log stored in the database. 40+ unit and integration tests.

title: CodexEngine
subtitle: Hybrid-Search RAG Service
summary: LangGraph pipeline with intent routing, question condensing, retrieval evaluation, and query-rewrite and web-search fallbacks. State is checkpointed in PostgreSQL and answers stream over Server-Sent Events. Retrieval combines pgvector with BM25, reranks with a CrossEncoder, and filters by user and thread metadata. Traced with Langfuse and scored with RAGAS.

title: rust-agent-core
subtitle: Terminal Agent Runtime
summary: Single-binary Rust CLI with a multi-turn REPL and tool calling (document search, web search, file read/write, shell commands), gated by ReadOnly, Safe, and Yolo execution modes. Generates embeddings locally with ONNX models, so indexing and search need no network call, and falls back to a second Gemini model when the primary fails.

title: Sarvam-1 Indic Instructor
subtitle: Indic Instruction Tuning & Inference Serving
summary: Parameter-efficient fine-tuning of Sarvam-1 (2B) for Hinglish, Hindi, and English using 4-bit NF4 QLoRA on 15,017 synthetic instruction pairs distilled from NVIDIA Nemotron-Super 49B, tracked in Weights & Biases, and served through an OpenAI-compatible vLLM + FastAPI backend.
